claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: RS-100329 is a selective alpha1A/1D-adrenoceptor antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; adrenergic antagonism is not cytotoxic and no plausible off-target cytotoxic mechanism is evident.
